other_conditions: Jointly owned houses are eligible; each separate family unit residing separately in the same jointly owned house is eligible
Age limit is 55 years, relaxed to 58 years for employees of State/Central Government/Corporation/Board or aided Institute
Applicant must own the house (individually or jointly), including mundcarial houses
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹5,00,000 at 2% interest for house repair or reconstruction, disbursed in two installments.
